Resolves #21341

`ROADMAP.md` is where a contributor or an agent starts, and four passages of its Engine 14 section still described the examples plan of 16 Nov: an overview page per group, a cover for every card, the workbench's second slice deferred as a whole, and records, captions and covers "open to contributors" although those leaves are closed.
